title: Understanding Linear Relationships
text: When considering if a relationship is linear, think about how the variables interact. A linear relationship means that if you plot the data, it should form a straight line. Consider how transformations like logarithms or square roots might affect this.

title: Exploring Transformations
text: Transformations like taking the logarithm or square root can linearize data that isn't initially linear. For example, if you have an exponential relationship, taking the logarithm might help reveal a linear pattern.
